examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{暖|あたた}かいブーツが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Warm boots are necessary in winter.

examples.japanese: レザーブーツを{手入|てい}れした。
examples.english: I took care of my leather boots.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}はレインブーツを{履|は}く。
examples.english: I wear rain boots on rainy days.

notes:
ブーツ (from English "boots") refers to footwear that covers the ankle and often extends up the leg.

COMMON TYPES:
- ロングブーツ (knee-high boots)
- ショートブーツ (ankle boots)
- ムートンブーツ (sheepskin/UGG-style boots)
- レインブーツ (rain boots)
- スノーブーツ (snow boots)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブーツを{履|は}く (to wear boots)
- ブーツを{脱|ぬ}ぐ (to take off boots)
- レザーブーツ (leather boots)

RELATED:
- {長靴|ながぐつ}: tall rubber boots (traditional Japanese word for rain boots)
- {靴|くつ}: shoes (general)

COUNTER:
{足|そく} for pairs: ブーツ{一足|いっそく} (one pair of boots).
